fact: On 25 March 2025 a digital tool for managing communal revenues (already used in Dogbo, Benin) was presented in Conakry for a pilot in the 13 urban communes of Conakry plus Coyah and Kindia, with MATD officials present, the association of communes saying all communes are concerned, and the Kindia head saying financing remains to be found.
title: Guinée: vers une digitalisation des services communaux de Conakry, Coyah et Kindia
